RUNMODE.TOOLTIP_DEFAULT: Default mode: production is allowed across the whole working temperature range; temperature only changes efficiency.
RUNMODE.TOOLTIP_CONTROL: Control mode: production only inside the best temperature range, and top-up heating runs while producing below the top-up line.

FORCEDRUN.TOOLTIP_ENABLE: Forced run: keep producing outside the working temperature range and keep heating. Materials, power, automation permission and building health still apply.
FORCEDRUN.TOOLTIP_DISABLE: Forced run is on. Turning it off re-evaluates production permission under the selected mode and keeps the current batch.
